backup_scope: resolved Docker named volumes from the public Caddy edge and owned NAV stack
owned NAV runtime-data bind mount containing South Africa OSM extract, Valhalla graph and PMTiles
runtime manifest, backup manifest and SHA-256 checksums
safety: never stop or mutate production services during backup
backup helper image must already exist locally
staging directory renamed only after checksums created
no automatic restore or destructive overwrite
restore drill uses only isolated temporary Docker volumes and a temporary data directory
limitations: live named-volume and bind-mount archives are best-effort and not guaranteed application-consistent while services are writing
restore drill validates archive extraction and Caddy configuration but does not start a full restored NAV stack
backup does not prove public DNS, TLS renewal or external connectivity
backup execution and off-node replication require NODE01 access
verification: perform a controlled full-stack recovery test before relying on disaster recovery
secrets_handling: secrets intentionally excluded; protect and back up separately through an approved secrets manager
